Heia er en av de gamle alpinbakkene i Ha: Heia is one of the old ski slopes in Harstad and still offers fantastic powder, the cozy Maistua, and playful skiing in terrain that is close and very popular among Harstad skiers, especially on weekday evenings. See the map and trip description here.
Hinnstein er et mye brukt turområde i Ha: Hinnstein is a frequently used hiking area in Harstad, similar to Heia. Hinnstein has steep sides, and it is the southeast side that attracts the most skiers, but be aware that several have been caught in avalanches there. See the map and route description here.
Sørvikfjellet er et flott skifjell nært: Sørvikfjellet is a great ski mountain close to the city that is steep and has several different lines where you can achieve high speeds. Be aware that avalanches occur on the steepest slope every year. See the map and route description here.
Haukebøtinden er den høyeste toppen i Ha: Haukebøtinden is the highest peak in Harstad municipality with a route graded KAST 1, meaning simple avalanche terrain. From the top, you can also choose complex and challenging descents. See the map and route descriptions here.
Sætertinden med sine bygninger er den hø: Sætertinden, with its buildings, is the highest peak in Tjeldsundet at 1095 meters, and with a primary factor of 1027 meters, the view is absolutely phenomenal. See the map and route descriptions for Sætertinden here.
Kongsviktinden er tett opp under 1 000 h: Kongsviktinden is just under 1,000 meters high and also offers fantastic views over Tjeldsundet and the beautiful alpine mountains surrounding it. See the map and route description here.
Litlehornet er toppen som får snø når de: Litlehornet is the peak that gets snow when it rains in Harstad and has nice powder snow when it is often blown away in other places. The route to the top of Litlehornet is in gentle and safe terrain suitable for beginners and children. See the map and route description here.
Trollfjellet er eneste topp på øya over: Trollfjellet is the only peak on the island over 1000 meters and is the finest ski trip you can take in the afternoon in late winter. See the map and trip description for Trollfjellet here.
Siriskolten er en drømmetopp for nybegy: Siriskolten is a dream peak for beginners who want a summit that is not avalanche-prone, easy to navigate, has little forest, and no steep sections. Here, those with a fear of heights can relax. See the map and route description for Siriskolten here.
Taraldsviktinden er en flott topp med sl: Taraldsviktinden is a beautiful peak with a gentle ascent all the way to the ridge. Incredible views over Tjeldsundet, Tjeldøya, and surrounding peaks. Several nice descents with varying steepness to choose from. On the east side lies the famous 'Tunellen', which is fun to ski through. See the map and route descriptions here.
Den innlysende renna man ser når man er: The obvious gully you see when you are in Fiskefjorden is tempting and fun to ski after being on the exposed Fiskefjordtinden. Incredible views of Strandtinden, Møysalen, and Tjeldsundet. See the map and route description here.
Strandtinden er Harstadområdets store k: Strandtinden is the great classic of the Harstad area, probably the most popular and well-known mountain for ski touring enthusiasts from Harstad and beyond. No wonder since Strandtinden has three steep descents and a side that is used with mountain skis. See the map and route descriptions here.
Nonstinden er den innbydende toppen du s: Nonstinden is the inviting peak you see when you drive past Gullesfjorden along Lofast. The peak has four steep descents with great views.
Middagsfjellet er et lett tilgjengelig: Middagsfjellet is an easily accessible mountain with nice skiing that has a long season. See the map and route descriptions here.
Kvasstinden ligger i flotte Øksfjorden: Kvasstinden is located in the beautiful Øksfjorden surrounded by steep mountains that call out to you. In good snow conditions, the descent is also a fantastic experience.
Aldeles nydelig topptur der det ofte er: Absolutely beautiful ski tour where there is often snow early and it lasts long. From the top, you can see out over Vestfjorden, and there is also an incredibly good view of Høgfjellet and Sebordtinden. See the map and route description here.
Fantastisk alpin topp der man trenger go: Fantastic alpine peak where good snow conditions are needed to get up. The peak is airy and offers an incredibly nice view. Skiing on parts of the return makes the trip very versatile and nice.
Sebortinden er en fantastisk skitopp i: Sebortinden is a fantastic ski peak in beautiful nature. Great route up, airy sections, and several lovely descents where there is often soft powder snow. See the map and route description here.
Durmålstinden er en av de virkelig bratt: Durmålstinden is one of the truly steep 1,000-meter peaks on Hinnøya. More of an alpine peak than one to ski from. The top of Durmålstinden is airy and the view is phenomenal. See the map and route description here.
Forkledalstindan gir deg panoramautsikt: Forkledalstindan gives you panoramic views of all the peaks in the National Park described in the book. If you want a great ski tour, you will find many descents, and if you want an alpine traverse, you can choose to walk the entire mountain from south to north. See the map and route descriptions here.
Flott tur der man går nært Øksfjorden og: Great tour where you walk close to Øksfjorden and get beautiful views into Vestpollneset, Austpollen, and the coastal alpine mountains around. See the map and route description here.
Med en primærfaktor på 1262 meter, og på: With a primary factor of 1262 meters, and in 19th place in all of Scandinavia, everyone understands that this is a place to go when you want a real view and to see a lot.
I et øde område der du får være for deg: In a remote area where you can be by yourself, Snøtinden is a fantastic peak that you simply must visit. Incredibly nice views that inspire many more trips in the area.
Stortinden ligger i Sortland og er en av: Stortinden is located in Sortland and is one of Hinnøya's 1000-meter high peaks. Along with fantastic views, Stortinden also has steep continuous skiing all the way down to the sea. See the map and route descriptions here.
Melåaksla er en fin tur i flott variert: Melåaksla is a nice tour in beautiful varied terrain rewarded with views over Austerfjorden, Jonsheimen, and Gullesfjorden. See the map and route descriptions here.
Hemmestadfjellet er et fjell der du tryg: Hemmestadfjellet is a mountain where you can safely and easily get up without a long approach. The view is great where you can see Middagstinden, Gullesfjord, and Kveøya. The descent offers smooth and easy skiing that is highly recommended for beginners. The west side offers more challenges. See the map and route descriptions here.
Vestsiden på Middagstinden er for mange: The west side of Middagstinden is for many Harstad locals a favorite mountain since it often has nice powder on the west side when other south- and east-facing mountains are affected by a lot of wind. See the map and route descriptions here.
Hvis du er ute etter en topptur som er l: If you are looking for a ski tour that is easy and safe to get up and want easy skiing, Storlitinden is for you. From the top of Storlitinden, you have a nice view even though it is not a proper peak.
Topptur til Høgfjellet betyr bratt renne: Ski tour to Høgfjellet means a steep gully with easy access and great skiing all the way down to the road. See the map and trip description for Høgfjellet here.
Her har man muligheten å ta seg en rundt: Here you have the opportunity to take a round trip from Skjærstad passing through two municipalities and three peaks that offer varied skiing and great views. See the map and route description for Grenserunden here.
Skittendalstinden er med sine 1306 meter: Skittendalstinden, at 1306 meters, is the highest mountain in this book. A fantastic mountain that is not difficult to climb, but it is a long way to go, and you can choose steep descents. The view is fantastic. See the map and route descriptions for Skittendalstinden here.
Melåplatået er som et paradis for den so: Melåplatået is like a paradise for those who want to enjoy the outdoors, fish, tranquility, and magnificent nature with many peaks that call out to be adorned with ski tracks. There are usually natural ski tracks all the way up to 'Holla' by Tverrelvtindan during the season. See the map and route descriptions here.
Er du fra Kvæfjord eller Harstad og født: If you are from Kvæfjord or Harstad and born with skis on your feet, you have of course been to Koven and Storhornet. A very attractive area where families can ski together with children of all ages.
Fra Dale kan man gå en kjempefin tur inn: From Dale, you can take a great tour into Dalsdalen where ski tracks are often made, or other tracks along the tractor road/summer path. A more challenging ski trip is Jamnfjellet. See the map and route description here.
Litletussen er en kjempeflott topp som: Litletussen is a fantastic peak that has many of the same qualities as Storetussen, but this one is easy to climb and has gentler skiing. See the map and route descriptions here.
Når det er nok snø og snøen er fin å kjø: When there is enough snow and the snow is nice to ski on, Slåttheia is an incredibly beautiful peak for beginners. You ski outside most avalanche terrain and the view is very nice. See the map and route description here.
Stortussen er et av de virkelige store: Stortussen is one of the truly large ski mountains that very few have visited. By taking a trip to Hattfjellet, you can see that the west faces of Stortussen simply must be skied. See the map and route descriptions here.
Hattfjellet ligger lengst unna fergeleie: Hattfjellet is the furthest from the ferry landing and has the best view towards Andøya, offering everything from easy trips to some of the steepest, most beautiful, and technically difficult skiing the island has to offer. See the map and route descriptions here.
Det mest vanlige er å gå opp til Skjelle: The most common route is to go up to Skjellesvikgalten, which is a forepeak to Storgalten/Fenesgalten (987 m), and from here ski down one of the sunny south faces of the highest class. This is on days when the snow is stable. See the map and route descriptions here.
Nona er Grytøyas høyeste fjell, «kongen»: Nona is Grytøya's highest mountain, the 'king' for the more experienced skiers on days with stable snow. The view is as phenomenal as the descent, not without reason that Nona was the favorite ski mountain of the great local skier Olav Solberg. See the map and route description here.
Trolltinden føles på mange måter som «pr: Trolltinden feels in many ways like the 'prince' compared to the 'king' Nona. Trolltinden has equally spectacular views but is a bit smaller, and the skiing is a bit gentler. See the map and more route descriptions here.
Lundenesgalten er den store flotte fjell: Lundenesgalten is the large beautiful mountain face you see from Harstad, and many have it as a dream mountain when they grow up. This mountain is truly beautiful to climb and the descent is smooth and superb. See the map and route descriptions here.
Rolla og Lasselitinden er fjellene som a: Rolla and Lasselitinden are the mountains that everyone from Harstad sees, with Tjeldenelva in the middle. In winter, this freezes and offers great ice climbing. See the map and route descriptions here.
Sula er et veldig populært fjell siden m: Sula is a very popular mountain since you can also use mountain skis there. Sula and the neighboring peak Sæta are easy to recognize from Harstad with their distinct M-formation.
Enkleste rute opp til en av Drangens flo: The easiest route up to one of Drangen's beautiful peaks. Great views and nice skiing. On the east side of Rundtind lies a pinnacle called Tottålen.
Mellatinden har bratte flotte nedkjøring: Mellatinden has steep beautiful descents on both sides. The west side has the sun and great views of Lasselitinden.
Snøtind er den største klassikeren for b: Snøtind is the biggest classic for steep skiing on Andørja. Spectacular views and exciting descents no matter where you ski.
Ristinden som sees tydelig fra Ånstad, t: Ristinden, which is clearly visible from Ånstad, offers steep descents. The view from the top is great where you can see all of Rolla and a fantastic view over Straumsbotn with all the mountains on the north side. See the map and route descriptions for Ristinden here.
Åtinden er en skikkelig bratt topp som k: Åtinden is a really steep peak that only has two narrow, long, steep gullies on the west side. See the map and route descriptions here.
Kråktindan og Middagstinden er en lang f: Kråktindan and Middagstinden form a long mountain range, and the north side has countless descents with varying difficulty. Combined with a boat, you can easily reach the innermost lines. See the map and route description here.
Hvis du først har gått opp på Middagsfje: If you have already hiked up Middagsfjellet, just follow the ridge towards Kråktindan. It can be partially blown away, so in some places you may occasionally have to carry your skis. Choose one or two descents, but check the snow first, as this is avalanche terrain where avalanches occur every year. See the map and route descriptions for Kråktindan here.
Langlitinden er Andørjas høyeste topp, o: Langlitinden is Andørja's highest peak, and also the highest peak in the Nordics on an island. With a primary factor of 1276 meters and three fantastic different descents with 1276 effective vertical meters, Langlitinden is truly worth a visit regardless of your skiing level. See the map and route descriptions here.
Kråkrøtinden byr på bratt kjøring med ef: Kråkrøtinden offers steep skiing with effective vertical meters. The peak has great views towards Lavangen and Salangen and can be climbed from either the north or south. See the map and route descriptions here.
Skartinden har som nabotoppen Vasskartin: Skartinden, like the neighboring peak Vasskartinden, offers fantastic views, and from here there is steep beautiful skiing from the top when there is enough snow, and the snow is stable and not crusty. See the map and route description here.
Vasskardtinden er Andørjas svar på Matte: Vasskardtinden is Andørja's answer to the Matterhorn in appearance. The peak itself is not particularly suitable for skiing, but more of an alpine challenge that can be taken when you are on your way up to Skartinden, which is the neighboring peak. See the map and route descriptions here.
Klåptind er lett å se fra Engenes, og fj: Klåptind is easy to see from Engenes, and the mountain can, in seasons with a lot of snow, offer great skiing and very good views.
Skrårenna opp til toppen av Årbostadtind: The gully up to the top of Årbostadtinden is a landmark that many have skied down both early and late in the season. Excellent views of Senja and Dyrøy. See the map and route descriptions here.
Horntindan er et flott skifjell med fler: Horntindan is a great ski mountain with several descents and fantastic views over Gullesfjorden and its beautiful mountains. See the map and route descriptions here.
Nattmålsfjellet er et nært og kjært ski: Nattmålsfjellet is a close and beloved ski mountain that is often used for skiing since it is so easily accessible in Kilbotn and has terrain with a lot of nice and varied skiing. Nattmålsfjellet can be skied up and down several times while still seeking new lines. See the map and route descriptions here.
Når man kjører inn Fiskefjorden ser man: When you drive into Fiskefjorden, you often see the steep Hestfjellet, which is climbed in summer. See the map and route descriptions for Fiskefjorden here.
Vil du opp på høyfjellet og oppleve fin: If you want to go to the high mountains and experience beautiful untouched nature, head to Jonsheimen. This is a great area where you can camp in a tent or stay in one of the cabins here. See the map and route description here.
Kanstadbotn er startpunktet for turene o: Kanstadbotn is the starting point for trips up to Toralfsbu and further over to Håkonsbu and the beautiful Jonsheimen. The nature is mostly untouched and you can experience beautiful high mountains where you don't have to see cars and other stress. See the map and route descriptions for Kanstadbotn here.
Austerfjorden er en avstikker til Gulles: Austerfjorden is a detour to Gullesfjorden and is pleasantly remote. Here you get peace and quiet as you slowly but surely leave the sea and disappear into the mountains. See the map and route description here.
Finnslettheia er en lett tilgjengelig h: Finnslettheia is an easily accessible high mountain that many seek for day trips or for overnight stays in tents or snow caves.
Kaltdalen, ved Sollia Alpinsenter, har n: Kaltdalen, by Sollia Alpinsenter, has some of the best skiing you can get in the area with untouched powder even when all loose snow has been blown away in all of Harstad. See the map and route description for Kaltdalen here.
Keipen av de få toppene med kort anmarsj: Keipen is one of the few peaks with a short approach, spectacular views, and is in terrain completely free of avalanche danger regardless of snow conditions. See the map and route description here.
Rundfjellet er et blikkfang når du kjøre: Rundfjellet is a sight to behold when you drive from Sørvika towards Bjørnhaugen. The top of Rundfjellet offers some approach and nice skiing in cruising terrain. See the map and route description here.
Tverrfjellet er en fin topp som er sydve: Tverrfjellet is a nice peak that faces south with an easy ascent and simple but fun skiing down. Tverrfjellet is recommended for beginners who want a bit of length and variation from other peaks. See the map and route description here.
En utrolig fin alpin tur som gir deg fan: An incredibly beautiful alpine tour that gives you fantastic views over all the mountains you will visit around you, as well as the sea on all sides. Crampons and an alpine axe are recommended. See the map and route descriptions for Jotind here.
Snøtinden er et fjell som er lett tilgje: Snøtinden is a mountain that is easily accessible from the Tourist Association's cabins Toralfsbu and Håkonsbu and has several gentle descents that are good for beginners who want to go to a high mountain. See the map and route description here.
Fjelltoppen med en pinakkel på siden som: The mountain peak with a pinnacle on the side that is worth climbing up to get the real peak feeling. From Jakobstinden, you get fantastic views over the entire Melåplatået, Kongsvikdalen, Jonsheimen, and Tjeldsundet. See the map and route descriptions here.
Vetefjellet er et lekent skifjell som ha: Vetefjellet is a playful ski mountain that has a short approach and nice forest skiing. Above the tree line, it has fun steep slopes that you can play on when conditions are safe.
Villdalsfjellet er et flott enkelt skif: Villdalsfjellet is a great simple ski mountain that involves a bit of alpine climbing in the last part up as the icing on the cake. Great views and gentle skiing where you can really get some speed down. See the map and route descriptions here.
Novatinden er en luftig topp som gir fan: Novatinden is an airy peak that offers fantastic views. The peak requires a bit of alpine climbing after having walked up a long steep gully that gets steeper and steeper further up. See the map and route description here.
Snytindhytta er en veldig populær hytte: Snytindhytta is a very popular cabin in winter, much due to the untouched beautiful nature. Snytindhytta is large and has a great standard with a sauna and is a good starting point for ski tours on the steep mountains around. See the map and route description here.
Alpint flott bratt fjell som også gir fl: Alpine beautiful steep mountain that also offers great skiing, but has a long approach and much time must be spent in avalanche terrain. This trip is only taken on the few days in the season that have 100% stable snow.
Stortinden er det eneste fjellet på Roll: Stortinden is the only mountain on Rolla that is over 1000 meters and offers the steepest descents on Drangen. Only skiing when there is stable snow.
Bratt, flott skitopp som gir deg utsikt: Steep, beautiful ski peak that gives you views over an area with high tempting peaks. The summit point on the ridge can, under difficult conditions, require both an axe, crampons, and rope. See the map and route description for Grindalstind here.
Pungdalstinden har aldeles nydelig utsik: Pungdalstinden has absolutely beautiful views from exciting mountains that are some of the closest you get to a natural pyramid. See the map and route descriptions here.
Forselvtinden er en liten avstikker hvis: Forselvtinden is a small detour if you have been to Lakselvtinden and the trip up is absolutely worth it. The view from the top is spectacular if you like high mountains over fjords, and you can also see directly at Møysalen as well as the steep beautiful descents from Møyene. See the map and route description here.
Flott utsikt fra et fjell som er veldig: Great views from a mountain that is very popular in summer. Under stable conditions with enough snow, the Toppen is one of the finest south-facing gullies on Grytøya. See the map and route descriptions here.
Helligtinden er en fantastisk topp for: Helligtinden is a fantastic peak for beginners and for everyone on days with unstable snow. Here you get great views and can really let your skis point downwards. See the map and route description here.
Kvæfjords høyeste topp og eneste over 10: Kvæfjord's highest peak and the only one over 1000 meters gives you a long beautiful ski trip and an alpine challenge if you want to go all the way to the top. Hinnøya's second highest peak after Møysalen.
Kongsvik er med Kongsvikdalen utgangspun: Kongsvik is, with Kongsvikdalen, the starting point for trips up to the beautiful Jonsheimen with Håkonsbu. See the map and route description here.
Dette er ei rute som anbefales på senvin: This is a route that is recommended in late winter with plenty of daylight and more stable snow conditions. Probably the routines are faster and the techniques better after a whole winter season of trips. See the map and route description for Grytøya High Five here.
Andørja på tvers: Ruta starter på Ånstad: Andørja across: The route starts at Ånstad and goes via Snøtinden, Stortinden, Botntinden, and Langlitinden to Isvatnet and down to Fornes. See the map and route description here.
Tjeldsunds Great 4 er en travers for de: Tjeldsunds Great 4 is a traverse for the alpine interested and gives you a physical challenge as well as a fantastic hiking experience in a beautiful area with great mountains and steep wonderful skiing. See the map and route description here.
Tjeldøya på tvers: Ruta går fra Breivikb: Tjeldøya across: The route goes from Breivikbotn up to Helligtinden, then down to Trollvatnet and up the south side of Trollfjellet. Then it is down to water 514 and then up to Stampen and Jotind. See the map and route description here.
Fantastisk travers der man går innom man: Fantastic traverse where you pass many high beautiful peaks with fantastic views. The area around Niingen is wild and beautiful where you can create many variations along the way.
Fantastisk fin skitur som går over hele: Fantastic nice ski trip that goes over all of Rolla from Fugleberg in the north to Indre Forså in the south. You can enjoy the view towards Drange and Rolla / Lasselitinden all the way.
Skipsvatnet og Mevatnet er begge lange f: Skipsvatnet and Mevatnet are both long beautiful lakes that lie between Rolla and Drangen. Great views and little elevation. See the map and route description here.
Topptur til Rombakstøtta (Áhkačohkka). R: Ski tour to Rombakstøtta (Áhkačohkka). Rombakstøtta is a real eye-catcher when you approach Narvik either from Sweden or on the E6 from the north.
Topptur Nordalsfjell. Heter Gátterčohkka: Ski tour to Nordalsfjell. Known as Gátterčohkka on the map, but everyone calls it Nordalsfjell or Nordals. This is a trip that anyone can do.
Topptur til Beisfjordtøtta. Et fjell med: Ski tour to Beisfjordtøtta. A mountain with many secrets. If you take the lift in Narvikfjellet and continue up to Tredjetoppen, you will see some of the secrets.
Topptur til Tredjetoppen. Akkurat som fo: Ski tour to Tredjetoppen. Just like for the main streets in Narvik city center, it is easy to keep track of the names of the peaks in Fagernesfjellet.
Topptur til Storfjellet. Det optimale to: Ski tour to Storfjellet. The optimal ski touring mountain, some would say. Grand glaciers, beautiful passes, fantastic bowls, and wonderful descents.
Topptur til Nihkečohkka. En lekker utsik: Ski tour to Nihkečohkka. A beautiful viewpoint where you can have the ride of your life. The peaks around here are high and wild, with glaciers and cliffs in abundance.
Topptur til Rienatčohkka. Rienatčohkka e: Ski tour to Rienatčohkka. Rienatčohkka is a real candy peak! You see it from Lossihyttene as a perfectly symmetrical pyramid.
Topptur til Rienatčohkka. Fjellene inne: Ski tour to Rienatčohkka. The mountains inside Skamdalsvatnet are wild. The wildest and highest of them all is Rienatčohkka.
Topptur til Tverrdalsfjellet. En smal sn: Ski tour to Tverrdalsfjellet. A narrow snow gully that winds down towards Skamdalsvatnet. Embedded between 100-meter-high cliff walls that prevent the sun from reaching in.
Topptur til Raudtinden. Raudtinden er en: Summit tour to Raudtinden. Raudtinden is a perfect trip to start your ski touring career or as a gentle introduction at the beginning of the season.
Topptur til Steintuva. Til tross for at: Summit tour to Steintuva. Despite being on the sunny side of the mighty Sovende dronning, Steintuva is in many ways overshadowed by Dronninga.
Topptur til Sovende dronning (Skjomtinde: Summit tour to Sovende dronning (Skjomtinden). Together with Rombakstøtta, 'Dronninga' is Narvik's pride.
Topptur til Litletind. Litletind er bare: Summit tour to Litletind. Litletind is just a forepeak of Sovende Dronning, but is still a very popular destination for locals.
Topptur til Gangnesaksla. Gangnesaksla e: Summit tour to Gangnesaksla. For many, Gangnesaksla is synonymous with the spectacular snow gully that runs northeast from the summit straight down into the fjord Sørskjomen.
Topptur til Meraftestinden. Å kjøre inn: Summit tour to Meraftestinden. Driving along the fjord Sørskjomen to Skjombotn feels like entering a world where nature's creators worked overtime.
Topptur til Middagsfjellet. Skituren til: Summit tour to Middagsfjellet. The ski trip to Middagsfjellet is a shorter alternative to Gangnesaksla and Meraftestinden.
Topptur til Lappviktinden. På vei inn la: Summit tour to Lappviktinden. On the way into Skjomen, Lappviktinden can be seen from afar, rising from the fjord like an impregnable fortress.
Topptur til Suorječohkka. En vel bevart: Summit tour to Suorječohkka. A well-kept secret in the heart of Skjomdalen. Fantastic skiing in steep slopes in the fall line down towards the valley.
Topptur til Durmålstinden. Topptursesong: Summit tour to Durmålstinden. The ski touring season on Durmålstinden is short but sweet. From Durmålstinden, you get intense and efficient skiing.
Topptur til Ippočohkka. Når badebuksene: Summit tour to Ippočohkka. When the swim trunks are out and soft ice cream is in everyone's hands, it's time to head to Ippočohkka.
Topptur til Storsteinsfjellet. Det høyes: Summit tour to Storsteinsfjellet. The highest mountain always has an extra allure, and in Narvik, Storsteinsfjellet is the tallest.
Topptur til Huinnarčohkka. Huinnarčohkka: Summit tour to Huinnarčohkka. Huinnarčohkka is a granite cone that rises majestically in the landscape. An airy peak that gives you a full overview.
Topptur til Rundtinden. Når snøen har sm: Summit tour to Rundtinden. When the snow has melted further down in the valleys and green leaves are on the trees, you can still find great skiing at altitude.
Topptur til Storriten (Stuorrarijdda). E: Summit tour to Storriten (Stuorrarijdda). A Norwegian summer hike in Sweden. The border takes a sharp turn north here, splitting Storriten in half.
Topptur til Loasevárri. En tur til Loase: Summit tour to Loasevárri. A trip to the top of Loasevárris is perfect for getting a great view and a good overview of the peaks around Lossihyttene.
Topptur til Rånkeipen. En av de absolutt: Summit tour to Rånkeipen. One of the absolutely finest viewpoint peaks in the entire area. You can see not only Ofotfjorden and the mountains on the northern side.
Topptur til Klubbviktinden. På grunn av: Summit tour to Klubbviktinden. Due to the difficulty and complex terrain, Klubbviktinden is one of the least visited peaks in the Narvik area.
Topptur til Reintind. Å nå starten på en: Summit tour to Reintind. Starting a summit tour by kayak or boat spices up the experience. You truly get to experience the contrast between fjord and mountain.
Topptur til Tverrfjellet. Et fint og lit: Summit tour to Tverrfjellet. A nice and slightly shorter alternative to Frostisen. But with a vertical drop of 1350 meters, this is also a relatively long trip.
Topptur til Frostisen. Det høyeste punkt: Summit tour to Frostisen. The highest point on Frostisen rises among the surrounding glaciers. The area is characterized by wilderness and few visitors.
Topptur til Simlefjellet. Sepmola som fj: Summit tour to Simlefjellet. Sepmola, as the mountain is colloquially known, is a massif where ridges and spines run out in all directions from the summit.
Topptur til Vargfjordtinden. Vargfjordti: Summit tour to Vargfjordtinden. Vargfjordtinden and its surroundings are a small buffet of hiking options and skiing opportunities.
Topptur til Kulhornet. Den smale og brat: Summit tour to Kulhornet. The narrow and steep snow gully on the west side of the pointed Kulhornet is clearly visible when you pass on the E6 below the mountain.
Topptur til Kobbenestinden. Stetind er d: Summit tour to Kobbenestinden. Stetind is the most famous and grand, but other mountains like Kobbenestinden definitely deserve attention.
Topptur til Titinden ved Narvik. Vil du: Summit tour to Titinden near Narvik. If you want a relatively easy and short summit tour in the area around Stetind, Titinden is a good option.
Topptur til Stetinden / Halls fortopp. S: Summit tour to Stetinden / Halls forepeak. Stetind is Norway's national mountain. It is also one of Norway's most beautiful and best summit tours with skis.
Topptur til Presttinden. Akkurat som Ste: Summit tour to Presttinden. Just like Stetind, the neighboring peak Presttinden appears as a destination that is impossible without a good deal of advanced climbing.
Topptur til Litletinden. Den smale toppk: Summit tour to Litletinden. The narrow summit ridge is an incredible experience. You can see miles around you since it is far to the nearest high mountain to the west.
Topptur til Niingen. Fra Bogen vises Nii: Summit tour to Niingen. From Bogen, Niingen appears as a peak with sheer cliff walls, taken straight out of the darkest chapters of The Lord of the Rings.
Topptur til Skittendalstinden. Fjellets: Summit tour to Skittendalstinden. The mountain's inaccessibility means it is rarely climbed. However, it is still a pleasant trip with plenty of views.
Topptur til Novafjellet (Orus). Etter et: Summit tour to Novafjellet (Orus). After a rockslide, Novatind acquired a profile resembling the nose of then British Prime Minister Winston Churchill.
Topptur til Revtind. Revtind karakterise: Summit tour to Revtind. Revtind is characterized by the sharp rock towers of the summit ridge just north of the main peak. Two of the rock towers look like fox ears.
Topptur til Oldertinden. Oldertinden er: Summit tour to Oldertinden. Oldertinden is one of the most difficult and lesser-known ski peaks in the area, and there are no easy routes to the top.
Topptur til Segeltinden. Segeltinden er: Summit tour to Segeltinden. Segeltinden is a very special summit tour. Imagine a black alpine slope stretched out in a descent of over 600 vertical meters.
Topptur til Keipen og Skorvetind. Ved od: Summit tour to Keipen and Skorvetind. At the point where Grovfjord meets Astafjorden, the peaks line up like pearls on a string. Two of these pearls are Keipen and Skorvetind.
Ved Blåvatnhyttene er du virkelig på tun: At Blåvatnhyttene, you are truly on the tundra. The nearest tree is many kilometers away. Rarely is the weather so marked and decisive for you as here, in a cabin out in the barren mountains.
Topptur til Nonsfjellet. Nonsfjellet er: Summit tour to Nonsfjellet. Nonsfjellet is a very good ski mountain. Both the south side and the large basin between Nonsfjellet and Kvannto offer wonderful skiing.
Summit tour to Nonstinden and Dudalstinden. Two of the lesser-known peaks in the area, despite being a prominent part of the horizon when standing in Narvik.
Topptur til Årsteinhornet. Her kan du ne: Summit tour to Årsteinhornet. Here you can almost smell the seaweed when you put on your skins. You are really close to the fjord throughout the trip.
Topptur til Stortinden. Den markante snø: Summit tour to Stortinden. The prominent snow gully that runs like a line down Stortinden is the first thing that catches the eye when looking at the mountain.
Topptur til Læigastind. Alt som er fint: Summit tour to Læigastind. Everything that is great about summit tours around Narvik is here: Open slopes, direct proximity to the sea, and fantastic skiing.
Topptur til Rivtind. Den taggete kammen: Summit tour to Rivtind. The jagged ridge on Rivtind can be seen from both Norway and Sweden. The highest point on the ridge is a mythical peak that few have reached.
Spanstinden ( Rungugáisá). En skikkelig: Spanstinden (Rungugáisá). A true classic and a very popular summit tour. On a sunny day, you can almost expect to meet people up on the mountain.
Summit tour to Melkefjellet (Mielkevárri). The large snow-filled basin to the west of the summit on Melkefjellet is a fantastic and fun descent.
Topptur til Sildviktinden (Ruoidnačohkka: Summit tour to Sildviktinden (Ruoidnačohkka). Before the road between Norway and Sweden was built, trains were an important means of transport when going on summit tours in the border area.
Topptur til Blåisen (Beajojiekna). Blåis: Summit tour to Blåisen (Beajojiekna). Blåisen is a peak that is easy to spot, but a bit tricky to know how to get close to and up on.
Topptur til Topp 1363 og Detasjementshøg: Summit tour to Top 1363 and Detasjementshøgda. It is unusual to have tourist association cabins where you can start from the cabin to so many different peaks in so many different directions.
Topptur til Ristačohkka. En av de mest i: Summit tour to Ristačohkka. One of the most interesting peaks around Hunddalshyttene, with magnificent views and exciting skiing opportunities.
Topptur til Gahperčohkka. Gahperčohkka e: Summit tour to Gahperčohkka. Gahperčohkka is Hunddalen's pyramid. An unmistakable landmark where the valleys Doaresvággi and Hunddalen meet.
Topptur til Sealggačohkka. Fra Sealggačo: Summit tour to Sealggačohkka. From the top of Sealggačohkka and down onto the glacier east of the summit, you get 750 vertical meters straight down in the fall line.
Topptur til Vomtinden (Váhttečohkka). Nå: Summit tour to Vomtinden (Váhttečohkka). When the snow in most other slopes in Hunddalen has been ruined by the wind and sun, there is usually a nice ski left here.
Topptur til Kopparfjellet (Noalči). Som: Summit tour to Kopparfjellet (Noalči). As a shorter trip when time is tight or as a trip for beginners, Kopparfjellet is really good.
Topptur til Nævertind (Beassetčohkka). E: Summit tour to Nævertind (Beassetčohkka). After the road between Norway and Sweden was built, the natural starting point of the trip became somewhat easier to reach.
Topptur til Bjørnfjell (Bonjovárri). På: Summit tour to Bjørnfjell (Bonjovárri). On one side of the border, there is wilderness except for a few hotels, a grocery store, and some apartment complexes.
Topptur til Láirečorru. Láirečorru er en: Summit tour to Láirečorru. Láirečorru is a relatively short and easy trip that you can fit in if you have half a day available.
Topptur til Vuoiddasriida. Vel verdt inn: Summit tour to Vuoiddasriida. Well worth the effort with the long approach. The triangular snowfield on the north side catches the eye and awakens the desire to ski.
Topptur til Vássečohkka. Er navnet ukjen: Summit tour to Vássečohkka. If the name is unfamiliar, perhaps Vassitjåkka is better known, which is the old way of writing the Sami name.
Topptur til Geargečorru. Geargečorru er: Summit tour to Geargečorru. Geargečorru is an unknown peak to most, but it is easy to reach and offers great opportunities for very nice skiing.
Topptur til Gorsačohkka. Gorsačohkka er: Summit tour to Gorsačohkka. Gorsačohkka is one of the most popular peaks for Riksgränsen's helicopter-based skiing, largely thanks to the snow conditions.
Topptur til Loktačohkka. Det ser ut som: Summit tour to Loktačohkka. It looks like a fortress when you drive along the E10. Nevertheless, the mountain is one of the most popular hiking destinations in the area.
Topptur til Bajip Gohpáčohkka. Det lille: Summit tour to Bajip Gohpáčohkka. The small mountain with the strange name next to Låktatjåkkahytta often has nice skiing, and the trip is quick.
Topptur til Gohpasčorru. Si «13-13» til: Summit tour to Gohpasčorru. Say '13-13' to an old Björkliden local, and he will immediately know what you are talking about. An incorrect indication on an old map has stuck as a synonym for Gohpasčorru.
Topptur til Låktajåkkahytta. Her kan du: Summit tour to Låktajåkkahytta. Here you can end a successful summit tour with après-ski beer at the bar followed by a three-course dinner at the restaurant.
Topptur til Slåttatjåkka og Njullá. Helt: Summit tour to Slåttatjåkka and Njullá. Ever since STF established itself in Abisko in 1902, the peak Njullá has been one of the most popular hiking destinations.
Topptur til Giron. Giron eller Kieron so: Summit tour to Giron. Giron, or Kieron as it was previously called, is often forgotten. It is not easy to stand out when you are in the shadow of Tjåmuhas.
Topptur til Tjåmuhas (Čoamohas). Til lan: Summit tour to Tjåmuhas (Čoamohas). Until well into summer, you can see the dazzling white east side of Tjåmuhas from Abisko tourist station.
Summit tour to Pallentjåkka (Ballinčohkka). The nature of Pallentjåkka is fantastic slopes and opportunities, and you can choose which direction you want to set your ski tracks in.
Topptur til Ballinbogičohkka. Lengst inn: Summit tour to Ballinbogičohkka. Deep in the valley Ballinvággi lies the glacier Ballinriehppi-jökeln, surrounded by cliff walls and a string of peaks.
Kvitfjellet er en topptur med utsikt! My: Kvitfjellet is a summit tour with a view! Much of the ascent goes along a 3 km long ridge with fantastic views over Eikesdalsvatnet and the alpine peaks around.
Dette er en litt mindre besøkt topp som: This is a slightly less visited peak that is easily accessible, right up from the road over Vistdalsheia. Under the right conditions, the summit tour to Kalvgjeltinden offers great skiing in moderate and playful terrain.
Dette er en av de kortere turene i områd: This is one of the shorter trips in the area and follows southeast-facing formations that often gather a lot of snow. The summit tour to Jamtetind has become one of the most popular in the area in recent years. There is often good snow here, and the view towards Eresfjord and the steep mountains around is fabulous. A great trip with a long season.
Kort og lett topptur til Vardefjellet so: A short and easy summit tour to Vardefjellet that also offers great skiing. The most common ski trip goes to the forepeak at 821 m.a.s.l. Here you get close to the fjord and have a great view of both the fjord landscape to the northwest and Trolltinden and Åbittinden to the northeast.
Skjorta er selve signalfjellet for Eresf: Skjorta is the signal mountain for Eresfjord and the most famous ski mountain in the area. On good days, it is a fantastic summit tour along a long ridge formation. The views along the way are impeccable, and the summit is very airy.
Goksøyra er fjellet med den store, bratt: Goksøyra is the mountain with the large, steep wall that rises directly above the village in the east. The summit tour to Goksøyra is known as the peak with a fabulous viewpoint, but it is also a great ski trip.

Toppturen til Tarløysa (kalles lokalt To: The summit tour to Tarløysa (locally called Torvløysa) is easy, short, and has a great view of the fjord landscape and the surrounding villages. The trip to Tarløysa has become a classic for those who prioritize comfortable ascents and great views over steep descents.
Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Skarven (104: Map and route description to Skarven (1048 m.a.s.l.) in Skorgedalen.
Topptur til Smørbottfjellet (Smørbotn),: Summit tour to Smørbottfjellet (Smørbotn), the neighboring mountain Skarven and Kirketaket in Isfjorden are the most visited ski peaks in the area. Easily accessible summit tour, several descent options with varying difficulty, and often good snow conditions are characteristics.
Turen over Strandafjellet går over en sl: The trip over Strandafjellet goes over a gentle mountain ridge and is therefore not considered a summit tour, but the trip offers incredible views for being so easily accessible.
Såta er fjellet med den karakteristiske: Såta is the mountain with the characteristic shape that resembles a haystack and is easy to see from the parking lot. Såta is nicely located on the north side of Ljøsådalen and is a summit tour a bit out of the ordinary. It stands out as an alpine peak in an otherwise eroded landscape.
Turen fra skitrekket over Standafjellet: The trip from the ski lift over Standafjellet can be extended all the way to Isfjorden and offers a ski trip with views that are truly exceptional.

Loftskardtind er toppen vest for Loftska: Loftskardtind is the peak west of Loftskardet (the highest point on the trip over to Måsvassbu). The summit tour to Loftskardtind has a steady and gentle ascent to the foot of the mountain, and the last 400 meters are consistently about 30 degrees steep in a large, southeast-facing bowl.
Kirketaket er et av Norges mest kjente s: Kirketaket is one of Norway's most famous ski mountains for summit tour enthusiasts. Besides being a beautiful sight when you approach Isfjorden, the summit tour to Kirketaket is also a well-known and beloved powder hole that people come from far and wide to ski in.
Søre Klauva havner fort i skyggen av sin: Søre Klauva quickly falls into the shadow of its larger neighbor, Kirketaket, but the summit tour has three beautiful but challenging ski lines. The southeast ridge, which is so prominent from Steinberget, is one of them.
Klauva er mest kjent som klatremål med S: Klauva is best known as a climbing destination with the South Pillar, which offers great rock climbing high in the mountains on solid rock. As a ski mountain, Klauva is most visited by people doing the Hesteskotraversen.
Toppturen til Kjøvskardtinden kan by på: The summit tour to Kjøvskardtinden can offer some great ski lines and is 100 meters higher than Kirketaket with much of the same shape. However, the mountain is much less visited than its twin mountain to the west.
Høgseternebba er neste fjellet innenfor: Høgseternebba is the next mountain inside Kjøvskartinden. The mountain is easy to spot, and the west face can look quite inviting. Nevertheless, the summit tour to Høgseternebba is relatively little visited.
Helvetestinden ligger i forlengelsen av: Helvetestinden lies in the extension of the ridge from Høgseternebba. The summit tour to Helvetestinden has sections that are exposed, and the views are magnificent!
Nyheitindene er tinderekken mellom Vestt: Nyheitindene is the peak range between Vesttoppen 1508 m.a.s.l. and Hovedtoppen 1598 m.a.s.l. The summit tour to Nyheitinden is most visited during periods of good skiing conditions in the spring. The top of Nyheitind can be reached from several directions.
Hoemtinden er en majestetisk og alpin to: Hoemtinden is a majestic and alpine peak that rises directly from Eikesdalsvatnet. For skilled skiers, the summit tour to Hoemtinden is a fantastic trip out of the ordinary.
Topptur til Blåfjell. Sørsida av Blåfjel: Summit tour to Blåfjell. The south side of Blåfjell is a classic summit tour in Sogndalsdalen. Locally, this trip has been referred to as 'the front side of Blåfjell.'
Blåfjellet er tradisjonelt et lite besøk: Blåfjellet is traditionally a little-visited ski mountain, but it is located among the finest of them. The summit tour to Blåfjellet is varied, and you have a good view of the beautiful mountains around. The descent is mainly north-facing and can have good snow when it is otherwise sun-affected.
Moanebba er godt synlig med sin bratte,: Moanebba is clearly visible with its steep, west-facing wall that separates Grøvdalen from Dalsbygda. Due to its fine location with a short approach and fantastic views, the summit tour to Moanebba is one of the most popular hiking trips in the area during the summer months.
Hurrungen er fortoppen til Store Venjeti: Hurrungen is the forepeak of Store Venjetind in the north, right behind Venjedalssetrene. The summit tour to Hurrungen is easily accessible, and when conditions are good, the mountain has several nice descents.

Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Lille Venget: Map and route description to Lille Vengetind (1820 m.a.s.l.)
Venjetindan er navnet på tinderekken fra: Venjetindan is the name of the peak range from Litle Venjetind and southward. The southern Venjetind is not considered a peak in skiing terms but is regarded as the point where the Venjetind ridge meets the ridge from Kvanndalstinden. It is natural to summit out when coming up from Kvanndalen.
Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Venjetinden: Map and route description to Venjetinden - Midtskaret (1660 m.a.s.l.)
Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Blånebba (13: Map and route description to Blånebba (1320 m).
Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Mjølvafjelle: Map and route description to Mjølvafjellet (1216 m) with an alternative ascent.
Toppturen til Hattan er en lang tur i ny: The ascent to Hattan is a long journey in beautiful skiing terrain. Generally gentle, but slightly undulating and playful. An excellent trip on nice winter days, preferably shortly after a light snowfall. A great long trip for the whole family.
Når man kommer fra Bjorli mot Romsdalen: When coming from Bjorli towards Romsdalen, it is hard not to notice Døntinden, as it lies like a mountain ridge extending from the valley. Døntind is the highest ridge you see, and it’s easy to feel tempted to take a trip here.
Toppturen til Brøstkampen er en kort, øs: The ascent to Brøstkampen is a short, east-facing trip that retains loose snow for a long time. The tree line is high here, about 900 m, allowing for good skiing even in poor visibility.
Toppturen til Rånåkollen er kort og effe: The ascent to Rånåkollen is short and efficient. The mountain often has good snow and offers fun skiing terrain with several alternative descents. The summit is easily visible from Bjorli towards the southwest, where it prominently rises from the valley. From here, you can also see the entire route up and down.
Topptur uten skredterreng. Kalles også f: A summit without avalanche terrain. Also known as Bjorlitoppen. If you follow the normal route along the large southeast-facing ridge formation, this is one of the few summits that is outside avalanche terrain. And it also has great skiing terrain!
Raudmyrhøa er hverken det høyeste eller: Raudmyrhøa is neither the highest nor the steepest mountain in the area, and as the name suggests, it is more of a 'hill' than a 'peak'. The glacier has polished the mountain so that it is smoothed on all sides. It is this terrain, along with its location, that makes the ascent to Raudmyrhøa a nice skiing mountain.
Rutebeskrivelse til Finnan i Innfjorden: Route description to Finnan in Innfjorden (1639 m).
Hesten ble allment kjent gjennom boka «T: Hesten became widely known through the book 'Toppturer i Norge' from Fri Flyt and has since become one of the more visited peaks in the area. Although Hesten is quite exposed to the wind, there is a good chance of finding nice snow towards Gjølbotnen and Steinbotnen. No approach, great views, and nice forest skiing are also keywords.
Taskedalskollen er en av de korteste og: Taskedalskollen is one of the shortest and easiest ascents in the area, but nonetheless a great trip! Here you get close to the alpine peaks in the area. If you choose the safest route, this is a trip that can be made safe from avalanches on most days. The trip is most commonly done late in the winter when it is possible to drive all the way to Bøstølen. On good days, this is a great trip for the whole family, and feel free to stop by the beautiful Taskedalshytta.
Nonstinden er tradisjonelt det mest besø: Nonstinden is traditionally the most visited skiing mountain in the Bøstølen area. Nonstinden is high and alpine from the north side but has a moderate south side. If conditions are good, the normal route is a popular trip.
Middagstinden er med sin alpine form bra: Middagstinden, with its alpine shape, is steep on all sides, and the Normal Route follows the only obvious path to the summit. This makes the ascent to Middagstinden feel particularly exposed and airy, requiring that those who travel here have knowledge, skill, and good equipment.
Toppturen til Innfjordsskarven går i jev: The ascent to Innfjordsskarven goes through generally gentle terrain, close to the fjord, and as you gain altitude, you will get an incredibly beautiful view of the surrounding fjord landscape. It is also recommended to continue from Skarven over to Klauva on the Måndal side.
Skjervan er den alpine «kammen» som er l: Skjervan is the alpine 'ridge' that is easily visible on the west side of Innfjorden. When you come out of the Innfjord tunnel, on your way to Ålesund, it is unmistakable. The summit can be reached from both the east side (Innfjorden) and the west side (Måndalen). The east side of Skjervan is the gentlest and has a lot of moderate terrain and great views. It is steep the last stretch to the summit.
Kjøsen ligger lett synlig til innerst i: Kjøsen is easily visible at the innermost part of Måndalen. The ascent to Kjøsen is easily accessible, and on the north side, there may be opportunities for dry snow throughout a long season.
Storbua er lett synlig i forlengelsen av: Storbua is easily visible at the end of Måndalen. Storbua lies behind Kjøsen and has a large valley on each side. Large glaciers have shaped the landscape into excellent skiing terrain. The snow in the two northeast-facing bowls lasts well into spring and offers opportunities for fantastic ascents in a vast landscape.
Øspetinden er «Måndalens Kirketak». Med: Øspetinden is 'Måndalen's Church Roof'. With its beautiful shape and location, the mountain has long been considered one of the finest skiing mountains in the area. The bowl-shaped sides usually hold snow for a long time, and the mountain is one of those that often has good skiing conditions. The ascent to Øspetinden offers fantastic views of the surrounding alpine peaks.
Blåtindane er en tinderekke på tre toppe: Blåtindane is a ridge of three peaks that forms the west side of Venåsdalen. To the west, they all have steep walls, but to the east, the terrain is gentler with ridges and bowls. Perfect ascent for good skiing!
Venåsdalen er en fantastisk dal som gir: Venåsdalen is a fantastic valley that offers opportunities for much good and varied skiing terrain in most directions. Svartvasstinden lies at the innermost part of Venåsdalen. From the valley, it is Venåsdalstinden that you see at the end of the valley, and this is where the ascent ends for most. Svartevasstinden is part of an airy wall, and you must climb a short rope length to reach the very top.
