Grøntinden er den pyramideformede toppen: Grøntinden is the pyramid-shaped peak that is clearly visible in the middle of the ridge between Kaldtind and Prosten. From Åndalsnes, it is easy to spot in the west, with its nice flanks towards the east and southeast.
Toppturen til Nordre Trolltind er lang o: The ascent to Nordre Trolltind is long and gentle except for the last 100 meters. The view from the top of Nordre Trolltind is enormous; from the gentle landscape on the west side, you come up to the summit and experience a different and more dramatic sight.
Store Trolltind er med sin alpine form m: Store Trolltind is, with its alpine shape, best known as a peak for climbers. The ascent to Store Trolltind has long been a classic for those who want a long, challenging, and airy trip with spectacular views.
Breitinden er den største og høyeste av: Breitinden is the largest and highest of the peaks in the Trolltind massif. If you want to experience the view from a peak with a 1700-meter steep wall straight down into Romsdalen, Breitinden is the most easily accessible ascent.
Storgrovfjellet er lett synlig fra Stigr: Storgrovfjellet is easily visible from Stigrøra with its large, west-facing wall, right above the first turns on the Trollstigen road. The mountain also has a beautiful, 600-meter high, south-facing slope, which is not visible from the parking lot. Here, there is little approach, and the ascent is even all the way.
Fjellet er godt synlig med den bratte, v: The mountain is well visible with its steep, west-facing wall right towards Stigrøra. The ascent to Stigbotthornet is steep from all sides and difficult to access except for a short period when you can find skiing conditions on the north side of the mountain or in the west gully.
Ringshornet ligger lett tilgjengelig til: Ringshornet is easily accessible, right by the road on the Valldal side of Trollstigen. The trip to Ringshornet is one of the shorter ascents in the area. It has moderate steepness and can, with good route choices and normal conditions, be done safely.
Toppturen til Østre Småholtinden ligger: The ascent to Østre Småholtinden is located just north of Ringshornet. The trips have the same starting point through the small forest, and the easiest route is somewhat shorter, gentler, and kinder than its neighbor to the south.
Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Alnestinden: Map and route description to Alnestinden (1665 m) - the shortest and fastest ascent on Trollstigen.
Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Finnan (1786: Map and route description to Finnan (1786 m) - Classic spring trip on Trollstigen.
Gjuratinden er den iøynefallende toppen: Gjuratinden is the striking peak that you see right behind Isfjorden when you drive in along the north side of the fjord. For climbing-skilled skiers, the ascent to Gjuratinden is a super trip that combines a beautiful ski trip with an airy climbing summit.
Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Gievdnerassa: Map and route description to Gievdnerassa (897 m) in the Finnmark Alps.
Kart og rutebeksrivelse til Aspenesfjell: Map and route description to Aspenesfjellet (576 m).
Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Giskedalstuv: Map and route description to Giskedalstuva (638 m).
Kart og rutebeskrivelse til Midtfjellet: Map and route description to Midtfjellet (500 m).
Kart og rutebeskrivelse opp og ned Kista: Map and route description up and down Kista (409 m).
Topptur til Lauvnostinden. Ein fin og po: Ascent to Lauvnostinden. A nice and popular ski slope that does not require transport into or out of a valley first. Often has good snow after fresh snowfall in spring.
Topptur til Nordre Dyrhaugstind. Nordre: Ascent to Nordre Dyrhaugstind. Nordre Dyrhaugstind is one of the classic ski trips in Hurrungane. The peak offers great views towards Skagastølstindane.
Topptur til Rasletinden. Rasletinden lig: Ascent to Rasletinden. Rasletinden is easily accessible from national road 51 and is considered one of the easiest 2000-meter peaks in Norway.
Topptur til Heimdalshøe. Turen passer fo: Ascent to Heimdalshøe. The trip is suitable for anyone looking for a safe ascent with gentle and nice skiing down to Maurvangen and offers great views.
Nautgardstinden er et lett tilgjengelig: Nautgardstinden is easily accessible from Valdresflya. Here you get a nice combination of uncomplicated skiing terrain and beautiful surroundings.
Topptur til Midtre Høgvagltind. Midtre H: Ascent to Midtre Høgvagltind. Midtre Høgvagltind is a beautiful and easily accessible skiing mountain in the heart of Jotunheimen, clearly visible from Leirvassbu.
Topptur til Loftet. Loftet er blitt et p: Ascent to Loftet. Loftet has become a popular skiing mountain starting from Sognefjellet. Here you can enjoy great skiing on large snow slopes.
Topptur til Store Tverrbotntinden. Ligge: Ascent to Store Tverrbotntinden. Easily accessible throughout the season, has many elevation meters, and offers a nice descent to the parking lot in Leirdalen.
Fanaråken (2068 moh.) har fantastisk uts: Fanaråken (2068 m) has fantastic views of Hurrungane. Fanaråken can be ascended from Sognefjellshytta or Krossbu over Fanaråkbreen, Turtagrø through Helgedalen, and Skogadalsbøen through Gjertvassdalen.
Topptur til Semmelholstinden. Semmelhols: Ascent to Semmelholstinden. Semmelholstinden is an attractive peak that offers beautiful skiing in a stunning glacial landscape.
Topptur til Blægja. Skituren på Blægja e: Ascent to Blægja. The ski trip on Blægja is a long mountain ski trip that many locals in Gaular and Førde have long had as an annual Easter trip.
Topptur til Kvamhesten. Kvamhesten, meir: Ascent to Kvamhesten. Kvamhesten, better known as Storehesten, is a prominent mountain that you see as a landmark from most other peaks in Sunnfjord.
Ein fin pudderdag kan rette opp ein elle: A nice powder day can make up for an otherwise poor winter.
Topptur til Snøheia. I vintermånadane er: Ascent to Snøheia. In the winter months, the north side of Viksdalsvatnet is framed by a long, white mountain range along the entire south side of the lake.
Topptur til Sandfjellet. Sandfjellet er: Ascent to Sandfjellet. Sandfjellet is an easily accessible gem located between the snow-safe valleys of Angedalen in Førde and Fimland in Naustdal.
Topptur til Indrebøfjellet. Indrebøfjell: Ascent to Indrebøfjellet. Indrebøfjellet is a short, easily accessible, and gentle ascent in a snow-rich area at the end of Angedalen near Førde.
Topptur til Svorstølsheia. Turen til Svo: Ascent to Svorstølsheia. The trip to Svorstølheia is a great trip for beginners and families with children who want to experience the joy of skiing in snow-covered slopes.
Topptur til Smådalsnipa. Smådalsnipa er: Ascent to Smådalsnipa. Smådalsnipa is a nice, short trip that is suitable both as a summit trip after work and for novice skiers of all ages.
Topptur til Høgefjellet. ­Nedkøyringa i: Ascent to Høgefjellet. The descent in a northwesterly direction offers steep fun on days when you don't have time for a long trip and is a nice evening trip in the spring sun.
Topptur til Eikåsnipa. Eikåsnipa er ein: Ascent to Eikåsnipa. Eikåsnipa is a short and easily accessible ascent suitable for most people and is well-suited as a beginner trip.
Topptur til Geitebotsfjellet. Her kan du: Ascent to Geitebotsfjellet. Here you can choose between airy and steep skiing down Pallefjellet or large, even turns in the sides down Geitebotnen or Blådalen.
Topptur til Isvassnipa. Den luftigaste o: Ascent to Isvassnipa. The airiest ascent of Isvassnipa is along Styggevassegga, while the route via Brandsegga goes through gentler terrain.
Sunnfjordbjørnen er ein juvel inst i Hau: Sunnfjordbjørnen is a jewel at the end of Haukedalen, where it lies like a crown at the edge of hJostefonni, which is an independent glacier plateau in Jostedalsbreen National Park.
Topptur til Blikelvholten. Denne turen s: Ascent to Blikelvholten. This trip differs from the other ascents in the area, with terrain that requires greater knowledge of safe route choices.
Topptur til Norddalselva. Ved enden av H: Ascent to Norddalselva. At the end of Haukedalsvatnet, five ridges meet to form a star of ridges and narrow valleys, with Norddalsegga lying in the middle.
Høres det forlokkende ut med elsykkel og: Does it sound tempting with an e-bike and a little extra help from a motor? Do you only know that you want an e-bike but not much more? Here is a guide to the different types of e-bikes.
Topptur til Gjerlandsheia. Gjerlandsheia: Ascent to Gjerlandsheia. Gjerlandsheia is named after the village at the end of Haukedalsvatnet and has been much used as a ski trip over the years.
Topptur til Nesfjellet. Nesfjellet byr p: Ascent to Nesfjellet. Nesfjellet offers a true fjord-to-mountain experience with a fantastic view over Haukedalsvatnet throughout the ascent.
Topptur til Venevassegga og Rundenova. D: Ascent to Venevassegga and Rundenova. These peaks go through clear and easy terrain and are a good alternative for a family trip with children.
Topptur til Tverrfjellet. Tverrfjellet l: Ascent to Tverrfjellet. Tverrfjellet is somewhat set back between the more commonly used summit mountains Blåfjellet and Nesfjellet and is relatively unknown.
Topptur til Blåfjellet. Frå toppen av Bl: Ascent to Blåfjellet. From the top of Blåfjellet, you get a nice view of the jagged peaks on the east side of Hjørundfjorden and beautiful descents.
Topptur til Ørnafjellet. Ørnafjellet er: Ascent to Ørnafjellet. Ørnafjellet is the highest point in the short mountain range called Rimmane, which lies on the north side of Rørvikfjellet.
Topptur til Storfjellet. Storfjellet gir: Ascent to Storfjellet. Storfjellet gives you magnificent views. The east-facing descent with small ridge formations offers terrain that is often wind-sheltered.
Topptur til Myranova. Myranova er ein ko: Ascent to Myranova. Myranova is a short and family-friendly ascent, where you are rewarded with great views and an east-facing descent in gentle terrain.
Topptur til Orkja. Orkja tyder ark (kist: Ascent to Orkja. Orkja means ark (chest) and probably got its name because the mountain stands alone without direct contact with other mountains in the area.
Topptur til Åsfjellet. Den ukjende naboe: Ascent to Åsfjellet. The unknown neighbor to the well-visited Olahansfjellet. Although it is easily accessible, this gem has remained completely anonymous.
Topptur til Knebben og Høgenuken. I den: Ascent to Knebben and Høgenuken. On the white side between Knebben and Høgenuken, you can choose from many varied descents.
Topptur til Såtefjellet. Såtefjellet er: Ascent to Såtefjellet. Såtefjellet is one of the mountains closest to Jølstravatnet, but is still little used in this context.
Av turane langs nordsida av Jølstravatne: Of the trips along the north side of Jølstravatnet, Blånipa and Høgefjellet are probably among the least known ascents. This despite the fact that the mountain peaks offer something special; 800 elevation meters of playful skiing all the way down to the edge of Jølstravatnet.
Topptur til Grønlifjellet og Litlebottse: Ascent to Grønlifjellet and Litlebottsegga. Grønlifjellet is the big brother in Gotdalen. Here you can choose between two wide sides with 700 elevation meters of steep and fine skiing.
Topptur til Bjørsetfjellet. Bjørsetfjell: Ascent to Bjørsetfjellet. Bjørsetfjellet is strategically located 'in the middle' of Jølstravatnet and gives you a fantastic view over the long lake.
Topptur til Dalefjellet, Rabben og Tverr: Ascent to Dalefjellet, Rabben, and Tverrlifjellet. The mountain range around Torsbotn forms a hidden skiing pearl where the season can last surprisingly long.
Topptur til Syskarnipa, Kvitsvornipa og: Ascent to Syskarnipa, Kvitsvornipa, and Skåhammarsegga. These mountains lie in a landscape that is quite different from most of what Sunnfjord has to offer.
Topptur til Gotdalsnipa. Gotdalsnipa er: Ascent to Gotdalsnipa. Gotdalsnipa is one of the classics in the mountains around Ålhus and has long been a regular ski trip during Easter for locals.
Topptur til Steinegga. Dette er ein lett: Ascent to Steinegga. This is an easy and short trip that is well-suited for the whole family. Since the ascent is south-facing, the trip is in the sunny side throughout the ski season.
Topptur til Grovabreen. Grovabreen er ei: Ascent to Grovabreen. Grovabreen is an old mountain skiing classic where the wave of summit trips has given life to many new and exciting descents.
Topptur til Olahansfjellet. Olahansfjell: Ascent to Olahansfjellet. Olahansfjellet is many Sunnfjord residents' first encounter with summit trips and is also one of the most visited peaks in the area.
Kvitefjellet har ikkje fått namnet sitt: Kvitefjellet has not received its name by chance, for on this north-facing side, the snow lies sparkling white for a long time.
Topptur til Isdronninga. Isdronninnga fi: Ascent to Isdronninga. Isdronninga can be found in several of Nikolai Astrup's motifs. From Astruptunet, you can clearly see the female body lying on its back in Husdalen.
Topptur til Søthaugsfjellet. Om du er på: Ascent to Søthaugsfjellet. If you are at Olahansfjellet, you can often see over to the north-facing side of Søthaugsfjellet and think, 'I will go there one day!'.
Med si jamne ryggforma side er Nonsnipa: With its even ridge-shaped side, Nonsnipa (Sanddalsfjellet) is a summit trip where all skiers, regardless of experience, can find the joyful skiing pleasure in the turns down the slope.
I det inste dalføret i Jølster finn du T: In the innermost valley of Jølster, you find Tverrdalen. In the narrow valley, a semicircle of peaks and steep mountain sides opens up, surrounded by Jostedalsbreen, and small glacier falls creeping down the mountain sides.
Topptur til Tortnegrøegga. Tortnegrøegga: Ascent to Tortnegrøegga. Tortnegrøegga has become a popular ski peak, and proof that all good things come in threes!
Topptur til Bolsetnipa. I området Skei o: Ascent to Bolsetnipa. In the Skei and Stardalen area, Bolsetnipa is the mountain with the gentlest and most family-friendly slopes.
Topptur til Klakeggfjellet. Dette eit fj: Ascent to Klakeggfjellet. This is a mountain worth considering on days when a lot of fresh snow has fallen that the wind has left undisturbed.
Ascent to Skafonnfjellet and Høgenipa. If you visit Skafonnfjellet and continue along the ridge to Høgenipa, you are following in the footsteps of William Cecil Slingsby.
Topptur til Håheimsfjellet. På bensinsta: Ascent to Håheimsfjellet. At the gas station in Skei, you look straight up at the mountain. Those who fill up with 'ski goggles on' quickly see the tempting gully.
Topptur til Trollebottseggane. Stardalen: Ascent to Trollebottseggane. Stardalen has many jewels to steal for those who enjoy skiing on steep sides and lures those looking for white gold.
Snønipa er omkransa av bre, og som den h: Snønipa is surrounded by glaciers, and as the highest peak in Sunnfjord, the mountain has a long season, where fresh snow can come far into spring. 'The Queen of Sunnfjord' is a beloved destination for both glacier hikers and ski enthusiasts, and is well-suited both as a summit trip and for mountain skiing. From both Høyset and Veiteberg, you walk in a dramatic mountain area with steep slopes, glacier falls, and long stretches of plateaus into the glacier. The route from Høyset is used as an expedition trip by families with active children and teenagers. From the top, you have a view out to the sea to the west, and towards Hurrungane and Lodalskåpa in the east.
Topptur til Sygnesandsnipa. Når du kjem: Ascent to Sygnesandsnipa. When you drive into Kjøsnesfjorden, you see the steep Sygnesandsnipa with sheer mountain sides that drop straight into the fjord.
Topptur til Hanekammen. Hanekammen ligg: Ascent to Hanekammen. Hanekammen is located by Oldeskaret, which was previously a route between the tourist villages Briksdalen in Olden and Stardalen in Jølster.
Topptur til Bjørga. Bjørga er ein av dei: Ascent to Bjørga. Bjørga is one of the most well-known peaks near Jostedalsbreen and is 'open all year' during the winter season for summit enthusiasts.
Med start frå den høgtliggande fylkesveg: Starting from the high-lying county road, you gain many free elevation meters to a relatively high peak throughout the winter, with great views from the top and a nice descent. However, be aware that the trip is quite demanding in several ways.
Med utgangspunkt i den høgtliggande fylk: Starting from the high-lying county road, you gain many free elevation meters throughout the winter. However, the trip is still quite demanding both up and down. In return, this is one of the highest and most beautiful mountains in Sykkylven, with fantastic views southward towards 'the three giants': Brekketindane, Slogen, and Jakta.
På grunn av tilkomsten frå den høgtligga: Due to the access from the high-lying county road in Strandadalen, Fremste Blåhornet offers a great ski trip in relatively easy terrain throughout the winter and spring.
Topptur til Kvitegga. Kvitegga byr på ei: Summit trip to Kvitegga. Kvitegga offers a great trip in moderate terrain that is accessible throughout the winter due to its starting point at the county road.
Tungremtindane byr på ein lang skitur i: Tungremtindane offers a long ski trip in moderate terrain and an incredibly beautiful view over Hjørundfjorden from the top.
Blåbretinden har blitt ein aldri så lite: Blåbretinden has become a bit of a spring ski classic, and the summit can be reached from both Fet and Trandal. Here we describe the trip up and down from Fet, while also recommending a transition trip to Trandal.
Turen til Klovetinden er populær, og uts: The trip to Klovetinden is popular, and the view from the top towards Regndalen is fantastic! Feel free to take the trip in the morning sun, which shines here early in the winter.
Skituren opp og ned normalvegen på forto: The ski trip up and down the normal route to the summit of Brunstadhornet is a classic ski tour: long, relatively gentle, and nice. The main summit offers greater challenges, both up and down.
Namnet på dette fjellet er eit av dei al: The name of this mountain is one of the oldest in the entire Sunnmørsalpane. The seafarers used the mountain as a landmark when sailing up and down the Møre coast, and since the snow-covered north face resembles the sail of a Viking ship, the mountain was named Råna. The ski trip to Råna is one of the old classics in Sunnmørsalpane.
Urkedalstinden får sjeldan besøk vinters: Urkedalstinden rarely receives visitors in winter, as the trip up and down is demanding, but for the experienced skier, this mountain has much to offer.
Slogen er kanskje det mest kjende fjelle: Slogen is perhaps the most famous mountain in the entire Sunnmørsalpane, both due to the incredibly alpine character of the peak and because of a long climbing history dating back to the early 1900s, when English climbers staying at the historic Hotel Union in Øye established several new routes on the mountain. In recent years, Slogen has also become increasingly popular among skiers.
Skruven byr på ein lang og fin skitur i: Skruven offers a long and nice ski trip in mostly gentle terrain that still leads you up one of the higher peaks in Sunnmørsalpane, with magnificent views towards Norangsfjorden and the steep peaks around. Since the trip is long even from Ringdalsstøylen, it is best to take the trip late in the spring, after the 6-kilometer farm road is open all the way to the end.
Synet av Jakta sett frå Kalnes inst i St: The sight of Jakta from Kalnes at the innermost part of Storfjorden on a beautiful spring day is mesmerizing, as the mountain rises like a mythical giant. However, the most common ski trip goes up from the opposite side and is quite demanding. In return, you get fun skiing down.
Risnosa byr på ein lang og fin skitur i: Risnosa offers a long and nice ski trip in moderate terrain, and a majestic view towards Slogen and Smørskredtindane from the top.
Kvitegga er det høgste fjellet i dei sen: Kvitegga is the highest mountain in the central parts of Sunnmørsalpane, and the mountain offers great ski trips from various sides. We describe the most common route. The trip is long but goes through relatively moderate terrain.
Turen frå Sellereite til Kårdalstindane: The trip from Sellereite to Kårdalstindane is quite demanding, with a consistently steep ascent both on the way up Kårdalen and on the side up from Kårdalsvatnet. In return, you get an incredible view from the summit area and a beautiful descent.
Jønshornet er eit krevjande vinterfjell: Jønshornet is a demanding winter mountain that offers ridge climbing, incredible views, steep couloir skiing, and a nice round trip with many ingredients for the experienced skier.
Turen til Randers’ topp er ein av dei me: The trip to Randers' peak is one of the most varied and beautiful of all spring ski trips in Sunnmørsalpane. On beautiful spring days, there can be hundreds of skiers at the top in a single day. On such days, there can also be a queue for those who want to climb the iconic peak needle Bladet, which is located nearby!
Turen til Svinetinden går i flotte omgje: The trip to Svinetinden takes place in beautiful surroundings in mostly gentle terrain, although the summit flank is steep enough. The view from the top is perhaps the best you can get in the entire Sunnmørsalpane, with the fantastic Molladalen to the north, the ocean to the west, the Kolåstind massif to the south, and Hjørundfjorden to the east!
Topptur til Levandehornet. Frå Levandeho: Summit trip to Levandehornet. From Levandehornet (917 m) on Kolåshalvøya, you can ski in steeper terrain directly from the top.
Nivane er eit særs lett tilgjengeleg fje: Nivane is a very easily accessible mountain that offers great and fast skiing, often in powder snow early in the winter. Few places give you quicker elevation meters than here!
Saudehornet er eit populært skifjell for: Saudehornet is a popular ski mountain for experienced skiers throughout the winter and spring. The reason is that the mountain is easily accessible from the center of Ørsta, and the normal route down is very direct and spectacular.
Topptur til Vallahornet. Lett tur i stor: Summit trip to Vallahornet. Easy trip in mostly avalanche-safe terrain with nice views towards Ørsta center. Feel free to take the trip with a headlamp in the evening.
Kyrkjetinden innbyr til fartsfylt køyrin: Kyrkjetinden invites fast skiing on a large slope with panoramic views over Ørsta. Feel free to take the trip in the afternoon sun in winter or in the evening sun in spring.
Vassdalstinden er eit av dei aller vakra: Vassdalstinden is one of the most beautiful mountains in Sunnmørsalpane. The beautiful peak pyramid is well visible both from the mountains in the ocean and from the peaks inside Hjørundfjorden. In addition, the mountain invites steep skiing on avalanche-safe days.
Turen til Kjerringa byr på flott skiterr: The trip to Kjerringa offers great ski terrain both up and down. The view from the top towards Kolåstinden in the east and Vassdalstinden in the west gives a strong feeling of being in Tindelandet.
Turen til Romedalstinden er særleg popul: The trip to Romedalstinden is particularly popular as an evening ski trip in May/June after the farm road is open all the way to Steinstøylen. It is timely to start at six o'clock on a summer evening, as you get to experience the sunset out in the ocean while sitting at the top!
Kolåstinden er «Kongen av Sunnmørsalpane: Kolåstinden is the 'King of Sunnmørsalpane', mainly due to its majestic appearance, but also because the mountain offers a great ski trip in moderate but varied terrain. On good Easter days, there can be hundreds of skiers visiting the top in a single day. On cold powder days in January, you have the mountain to yourself.
Fingersida har blitt ein svært populær s: Fingersida has become a very popular ski trip. Feel free to take the trip on a morning in the winter sun when there are good chances of getting a great descent in powder snow. The snow settles early in this area, and many therefore start their ski season here.
Nordre Sætretind gjev fin-fin krusing ne: Nordre Sætretind offers great skiing down the glacier towards Fladalen, but also provides several remarkable couloirs down towards Kvanndalen for the experienced skier.
Sylvkallen har etter kvart blitt eit myk: Sylvkallen has gradually become a much-visited ski mountain, both because the summit offers great views and because the entire trip to the top is easily visible and eye-catching from Standaleidet.
Toppen av Dalegubben er eit av dei aller: The top of Dalegubben is one of the most beautiful viewpoints in the entire Sunnmørsalpane, with the sharp peaks Holmshornet and Lynghalstinden in the foreground, Hjørundfjorden and Norangsfjorden at the bottom, and Slogen in the background. Moreover, it is not without reason that the descent down Skondalen has become a classic!
Turen frå Helgatun til Melshornet er let: The trip from Helgatun to Melshornet is easy, avalanche-safe, and is very much used by skiers throughout the winter. The view from the top towards Ørsta center and the mountains behind is beautiful – especially in the evening darkness.
Turen til Veirahaldet er moderat samstun: The trip to Veirahaldet is moderate while offering great views towards Vassdalstinden and Saudehornet from the ridge.
Turen til Blåtinden er meir krevjande en: The trip to Blåtinden is more demanding than the trip to the neighboring mountain Veirahaldet. In return, you can get a great round trip by heading down towards Ville in Bondalen.
Turen til fortoppen Grøthornet (1059 moh: The trip to the summit Grøthornet (1059 m) goes through easy and beautiful ski terrain, while the trip further up to Lisjetinden is more demanding. The trip is suitable throughout the winter but is particularly nice as an afternoon trip in the spring sun.
Fjellet er mykje vitja gjennom heile vin: The mountain is much visited throughout the winter due to easy access, great views, and nice descents, and has gradually become a small classic. However, be aware of avalanche danger.
Skårasalen har lenge vore mellom dei all: Skårasalen has long been among the most popular ski mountains in Sunnmøre. The trip up and down the normal route is moderate, and the view from the top is absolutely fabulous, with Hjørundfjorden deep below you, Jakta towering opposite, and Slogen rising above Norangfjorden. Due to a long and winter-closed farm road, it is most common to take this trip late in the autumn or preferably in the spring season when the road to Årsetsætra is open.
Frå Årsetsætra er dette ein relativt kor: From Årsetsætra, this is a relatively short trip that invites steep and beautiful skiing. Feel free to extend the trip to Langhornet if you start a bit late on a spring day and Skårasalen on the other side of the valley is already 'overcrowded.'
Dukhornet har etter kvart blitt ein noks: Dukhornet has gradually become a fairly popular spring ski trip, both because the mountain offers a long descent in moderate ski terrain, and because the view over the inner parts of Hjørundfjorden/Storfjorden is beautiful.
Vi tilrår denne turen anten tidleg på vi: We recommend this trip either early in the winter or late in the spring when the road to Saurssætra is open. Then you get a moderate ski trip with airy views from the top.
Normalvegen ned frå Snøhornet gjev fin-f: The normal route down from Snøhornet offers great skiing in moderate terrain. In addition, Snøhornet offers alternative and spectacular couloir skiing for the experienced skier.
Koppefjellet frå Aldalen gjev ein kort,: Koppefjellet from Aldalen offers a short, moderate, and nice ski trip, which you can take early in the winter, as the route is southeast-facing and thus provides morning sun even in the darkest winter months. Summit trip to Koppefjellet. Koppefjellet offers a short and nice ski trip, which you can take early in the winter or as a quick evening trip in the spring.
Hornindalsrokken er ein av dei aller mes: Hornindalsrokken is one of the most alpine mountain formations in the entire Sunnmørsalpane, notably visible from Solavågen where it rises right at the end of the long Hjørundfjorden. The ski trip up is long and somewhat demanding at the top.
Høgenibba byr på ein lett skitur i for d: Høgenibba offers an easy ski trip in mostly avalanche-safe terrain, while also providing a particularly fun descent down Guridalen, which often holds good snow.
Eidskyrkja eller Kyrkjefjellet er ein av: Eidskyrkja or Kyrkjefjellet is one of the truly classic ski trips in the region. The mountain is easily accessible after the road up to Skinnvikssætra is opened and offers great descents in moderate terrain. On good spring days, there can be hundreds of people visiting the top in a single day.
Ved munninga av den smale og vakre Dalsf: At the mouth of the narrow and beautiful Dalsfjorden, Snøhornet rises like a white pyramid and invites you to a great descent in moderate terrain.
Trollvasstinden og Bytingstinden ligg si: Trollvasstinden and Bytingstinden lie side by side, and these mountains offer a truly great ski trip both up and down, no matter which side you start from and end up on. Here we describe the trip to Trollvasstinden from Lisjebøvatnet, with the possibility of returning to Sanden sæter, but it is also possible to make a transition trip to Bytingstinden (see route 5.2). The trip from Lisjebøvatnet is particularly suitable late in the spring, after the road up to the lake has opened, and preferably as an afternoon trip, as Trollvasstinden holds the sun until late in the evening.
Turen frå toppstasjonen ved Harpefossen: The trip from the top station at Harpefossen ski resort to Klakken is relatively long but very gentle, making it suitable for those who do not like the steepest slopes.
Lisje-Toren merkjer seg ut som ein særle: Lisje-Toren stands out as a particularly alpine mountain formation among mainly more rounded mountains here in the southern part of Sunnmørsalpane. From the main road down in Bjørkedalen, you can see the impressive southeast face stretching up towards the top.
Topptur til Sandhornet. Sandhornet er en: Summit trip to Sandhornet. Sandhornet is one of the most beautiful coastal ski peaks southwest of Bodø, and it is not surprising that it is a recommended winter climbing trip.
Langenestinden er eit bratt og krevjande: Langenestinden is a steep and demanding mountain for the experienced skier, but the view from the top is impeccable and the couloir and slope formations from the top down towards Fladalen provide exciting skiing.
Heimste Kopphornet byr på ein fin liten: Heimste Kopphornet offers a nice little round trip that provides great views towards the majestic Kolåstind massif. The trip goes in north and west-facing slopes, making it well-suited as a spring ski trip.
Turen opp til fortoppen Grøthornet (1086: The trip up to the summit Grøthornet (1086 m) goes through easy terrain and provides plenty of sun on clear days, even early in the winter. The way further up to the top of Hellefjellet is somewhat more demanding.
Store Smørskredtind er den mindre kjende: Store Smørskredtind is the lesser-known neighboring peak to Slogen, but offers one of the most spectacular ski lines in Sunnmørsalpane. The line from the top and straight down the couloir formations towards Patchellhytta is well visible and quite spectacular from the ascent to Slogen.
Store Brekketind er ikkje mellom dei mes: Store Brekketind is not among the most visited ski mountains, as the summit also offers climbing challenges. But the view towards Slogen and Jakta is raw, and the descent is fun.
Å gå på Røyrhusnibba gjev deg ein skitur: Skiing on Røyrhusnibba gives you a ski trip in good, old-fashioned spirit. The mountain is easily accessible throughout the winter and spring and offers nice descents at angles of your choice.
Den vesle Eidskyrkja er mindre vitja enn: The small Eidskyrkja is less visited than the large one, but offers alternative and more demanding descents for the experienced skier.
Frostatinden frå Storsætra ovanfor Skodj: Frostatinden from Storsætra above Skodje is a nice ski trip in mostly gentle terrain, and the view from the top towards the south and west is beautiful.
Høgsvora (som er den sørlegaste toppen a: Høgsvora (which is the southernmost peak of Næremstindane) is a very common and nice ski trip in mostly easy terrain, and the descent to Kvanndalen is great.

Little visited mountain.

Enjoy the view from the top and then enjoy the wonderful descent that awaits.

The horseshoe that makes up the peaks above Ura is a sure snow collection place, and with a glacier as a base, this means that you can play with skis on your feet from the first autumn snow until well into summer. But be aware that the entire bowl upwards constitutes release areas for avalanches from several sides!

Populær og lett tilgjengelig topp med et: A popular and easily accessible peak with a lovely summit slope that can provide great skiing. Grand views towards Store Kjostinden and Istinden. Flott og spenstig tur til lite besøkt al: A beautiful and exciting tour to a little-visited alpine mountain massif in the central parts of South Lyngen. Ending along a beautiful ridge to the highest point. Mighty views towards the northeastern part of the Jiekkevarrimassivet.

Et flott skifjell. Populær og lett tilgj: A great ski mountain. Popular and easily accessible peak with opportunities for a lot of nice skiing of varying steepness. Majestic views towards Piggtinden.
Spennende og mindre besøkt topp med muli: An exciting and lesser-visited peak with opportunities for a lot of great skiing. Nice views towards well-known Lyngen mountains like Guhkesgaisa and Lakselvtindane.
En storslått topptur for entusiastene. S: A grand summit tour for enthusiasts. Like a little expedition with a long approach through majestic parts of Lyngsalpene. With views towards 600–700 meter high and almost vertical mountain walls. Here you will experience a truly large Lyngen mountain that has few visits, and which will give you a long and beautiful day in varied terrain.
Flott introduksjonstur til Lyngen. Ypper: A great introductory tour to Lyngen. Excellent beginner tour. Easily accessible peak with opportunities for a lot of nice and fun skiing on large surfaces. Great views towards the sea and mountains.
Flott og spenstig tur til lite besøkt al: A beautiful and exciting tour to a little-visited alpine mountain massif in the central parts of South Lyngen. Ending along a beautiful ridge to the highest point. Mighty views towards, among others, the northeastern part of the Jiekkevarrimassivet.
Et lett tilgjengelig, spennende, men utf: An easily accessible, exciting, but challenging ski mountain that can provide great, steep skiing from the top down towards Kjosenfjorden. With the Jiekkevarrimassivet as grand backdrops. A tour that is recommended on days with stable snow conditions!
Spennende og meget variert tur med oppst: An exciting and very varied tour with an ascent in a large mountain face. Beautiful ending along the ridge to the summit. From there, it's just to enjoy the grand views towards the alpine Lyngen mountains; the nearby Veidalstindene and to the south the majestic Jægervasstindene and Lenangstindene. Requires decent snow amounts.
Fjellet må ikke forveksles med sin mer b: The mountain should not be confused with its more famous namesake further south in the country. This is a beautiful and easily accessible, popular ski ascent tour that provides expansive views towards the alpine northern mountain world of the Lyngen Peninsula.
Lang, gedigen og bratt alpin skitur. Det: A long, gigantic, and steep alpine ski tour. This is a summit tour that requires stable snow conditions. The area is one of Lyngsalpene's mightiest and most alpine mountain massifs and was once voted Norway's most beautiful postcard motif!
Forholdsvis grei og utrolig populær tur: Relatively straightforward and incredibly popular tour with a lot of great skiing. Storgalten lies at the outermost point of Lyngenfjord. The view holds very high class. Perhaps Lyngen's finest! Where mountains, the open sea, and islands provide a truly maritime setting. A tour that is recommended!!
En av Lyngenhalvøyas sørligste topper, s: One of the southernmost peaks of the Lyngen Peninsula, which sees few visits. Long and nice approach with airy and exciting easy alpine finish along a narrowing ridge towards the summit. Has the best and most beautiful view towards Piggtinden! Recommended for those who want a truly beautiful tour in a great alpine environment!!
Majestetisk bretur midt i Lyngsalpene i: Majestic glacier tour in the middle of Lyngsalpene in a real alpine setting, starting at the shoreline. Grand views from the top.
Det kan diskuteres hva som er Norges flo: It can be debated what is Norway's finest ski tour, but regardless, the tour over the entire Jiekkevarrimassivet will rank high on that list, if not at the top. The tour to the top of Jiekkevarri is in itself a long and demanding tour with many vertical meters, which pays off when you reverently glide onto the roof of Troms and enjoy a 360-degree panoramic view of fjords and mountains. If you want to complete the entire traverse, another 5–6 hours and 300 vertical meters remain. But no ski ascender's life is complete until this tour is written into your CV. So it is hereby recommended! Just as long as your fitness is decent. For the skiing enthusiast who doesn't absolutely have to reach the highest point in Troms, Holmbukttinden (1668 meters above sea level) is an excellent goal. The descent from here offers 1600 vertical meters of fantastic and varied skiing.
Et spennende og meget undervurdert skifj: An exciting and highly underrated ski mountain that literally lies in the shadow of its neighbor, the much more famous Jiekkevarri. It doesn't see many visitors. A trip in a spectacular alpine environment with powerful surroundings. Magnificent views in all directions. Incredibly varied descents!

Dette er en flott og grei introduksjonst: This is a great and straightforward introductory tour to the Lyngen Alps with excellent views of the sea and the mountains in the northern part of the Lyngen Peninsula. Opportunities for plenty of great skiing.
Stort og utfordrende fjell i mektige omg: A large and challenging mountain in powerful surroundings. Magnificent views of many impressive mountains in a popular freeride area. Often good snow conditions.
Majestic, eye-catching, large mountain. It will provide a wonderful long day out on skis. Expansive views.
Spennende fjell som sjelden har vinterbe: An exciting mountain that rarely sees winter visitors. An alpine trip to a moderately challenging peak. Great views of other exciting destinations. Wonderful long descent.
Populær og lett tilgjengelig introduksjo: A popular and easily accessible introductory peak to Tamokdalen. Opportunities for variations of steeper descents. Often good snow conditions!
Store Russetinden er en majestetisk og u: Store Russetinden is a majestic and challenging peak that demands respect, but in return can offer exciting and steep skiing starting right from the summit. Grand views towards many other beautiful mountains.
Flott, spennende og lite besøkt topp med: A beautiful, exciting, and little-visited peak with great opportunities for wonderful turns. And for practicing good route choices.
Spennende, lett tilgjengelig, men kreven: An exciting, easily accessible, yet demanding and challenging peak with great opportunities for plenty of fine steep skiing.
Dette er et av Kåfjordalpenes mest popul: This is one of Kåfjordalpenes' most popular ski ascent mountains. It is easily accessible from the ferry dock in Olderdalen. The snow conditions are often good, and combined with varied and beautiful descent options, this trip is a real highlight. And the view towards the mountains and the sea is very beautiful. Recommended.
Et flott skifjell. Med den beste utsikte: A great ski mountain. With the best views of the Lyngen Alps. Often good snow conditions, and here you can enjoy large turns on wide open areas.
En spennende og skikkelig alpin skibesti: An exciting and truly alpine ski ascent trip to a little-visited peak. Much of the ascent along the 'Normal Route' is done with crampons and ice axes. The ascent is crowned with plenty of fine skiing.
Spennende og lite besøkt topp. Utrolig f: An exciting and little-visited peak. Incredibly beautiful views in all directions towards many other exciting ski mountains. Opportunities for plenty of fun skiing.
Kåfjordalpenes høyeste og mektigste fjel: Kåfjordalpenes' highest and most powerful mountain, with relatively challenging routes. The view is spectacularly beautiful towards the Lyngen Alps in the west, and eastward you see more unknown and exciting mountains. The normal descent offers about 500 vertical meters of steep, beautiful skiing. If you love expansive views, the alternative ascent is recommended.
Dette er en estetisk flott og grei tur t: This is an aesthetically beautiful and straightforward trip to a little-visited mountain. It requires some effort to find the way up through the forest, but then it’s a great track up a wide and nice ridge with exquisite views towards the Lyngen Alps. A nice mountain for working on terrain assessments and route choices. Opportunities for steeper descents.
En av Kåfjordalpenes bakgårdsperler. Gar: One of Kåfjordalpenes' hidden gems. Guaranteed not many have skied here. An exciting trip where you can challenge your skills in reading the terrain to make good tracks. Excellent views and guaranteed opportunities for plenty of fine skiing.
A snow-safe mountain that rarely disappoints. From the top, which is actually a flat ridge with several peaks of about the same height, there are opportunities to adjust the descents according to desires and skills. As with all peaks in Kåfjordalpenes, the view towards the Lyngen Alps is theatrical. But this mountain has its tragic history.
Det fineste skifjellet i Troms! Snøforho: The finest ski mountain in Troms! The snow conditions are often excellent, and the mountain has the best views of the Lyngen Alps. The normal route is nearly 100% avalanche safe. Above the tree line, the mountain is like a continuous long, wonderful snow surface where life can be enjoyed in large turns. Let it turn!
Flott fjell med litt bakgårdsfeeling. Sp: A beautiful mountain with a bit of a backyard feel. Exciting terrain that offers a longer, varied day out. Excellent views and a long season.
Gorzelvtinden er et flott toppturfjell s: Gorzelvtinden is a great peak for ski touring that has become popular in recent years. And not without reason. Short approach and often excellent snow that can lead to plenty of great skiing. From Gorzelvtinden, there are expansive views towards exciting neighboring mountains. See map and route description here.
En grei topptur som passer utmerket for: A straightforward peak tour that is perfect for those new to the ski touring family. Great views of the sea and mountains. Nice skiing on wide open areas.
Fin, liten og lett tilgjengelig topp med: A nice, small, and easily accessible peak with opportunities for plenty of fine skiing on wide open areas. A perfect beginner's trip. Great views towards Store Russetinden.
Lett tilgjengelig topp i lite besøkt omr: Easily accessible peak in a little-visited area. Easy terrain with opportunities for plenty of great skiing. A great beginner's trip and excellent for practicing terrain knowledge and good route choices.
